sources.title: Fringe Visibility and Which-Way Information: An Inequality
sources.author: Berthold-Georg Englert
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract; publisher full PDF unavailable. The finite-model proof in REPORT.md is supplied independently.
sources.supports: The visibility/which-way distinguishability upper bound is established physics, not GRUT novelty.

sources.title: Revealing the Emergence of Classicality Using Nitrogen-Vacancy Centers
sources.authors: T. K. Unden, D. Louzon, M. Zwolak, W. H. Zurek, F. Jelezko
sources.read_scope: Full six-page primary manuscript; Eqs. (1)-(6), Fig. 3 and accompanying tomography, preparation and recurrence discussion.
sources.supports: A controlled spin platform measures system coherence and conditional environmental records; the reported Holevo quantity is an information upper bound, not the Helstrom quantity used here.

sources.title: High-Efficiency Measurement of an Artificial Atom Embedded in a Parametric Amplifier
sources.read_scope: Full primary paper; introduction, Sections II-III and Fig. 4 protocol inspected in detail.
sources.supports: Independent experimental extraction of dephasing and record acquisition rates; unmonitored channels and detector efficiency are standard microscopic freedom. The continuous-rate ratio is not identified with this finite-model distinguishability.

local_record.scope: Sections 4-5, 7: imported decoherence, inherited Born rule, supplied noise/cutoff and no worked GRUT-specific pointer-basis generation.
Sections V.1-V.3: supplied split, Gaussian/linear truncation, causal/time structure, memory stance and borrowed KMS/FDT.
Ledgers A-11, A-13-A-15 and B-1: physical noise origin, accessible seed, partition, preparation and coarse-graining not generally generated.

novelty_claim: None. The packet derives a conventional baseline image and rejects promotion of standard complementarity or supplied access completeness to a new GRUT result.
